newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures edge higher, near peaks.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures edge higher, near peaks.

text.p: May 28 - IMM currency futures higher, on highs. Mark brokers saw good buying by one house, thought on behalf of a hedge fund, before Buba's 1200 CDT/1700 GMT statement on alterations to accounting methods. Report expected to lay out any plans for gold revaluation. Some brokers guessed if Buba does not revalue gold to help meet EMU GDP criterion, mark could rise.
